description: Add: X <- Y + X, drop stack
notes: Consumes X and Y; stack drops (T replicates into Z). Stack lift enabled for next entry.

description: Subtract: X <- Y - X, drop stack
notes: Y minus X; result in X. Stack drops; T replicates. Stack lift enabled.

description: Multiply: X <- Y * X, drop stack
notes: Consumes X and Y; stack drops. T replicates into Z. Stack lift enabled.

description: Divide: X <- Y / X, drop stack
notes: Y divided by X. Division by zero returns DATA ERROR. Stack lift enabled.

description: Lift stack and duplicate X into Y
notes: Disables stack lift; next digit entry overwrites X without pushing. T register lost.

description: Clear X register (entry cancel)
Change sign of X (negate)
notes: Negates X in place; stack unchanged. During digit entry: toggles mantissa sign. Stack lift neutral.

description: Roll stack down: X<-Y, Y<-Z, Z<-T, T<-X
example: Rv -> X=Y, Y=Z, Z=T, T=old X
notes: Circular rotation; no values lost. Four presses restore original stack. Stack lift enabled.

description: Roll stack up: X<-T, T<-Z, Z<-Y, Y<-X
Swap X and Y registers
notes: Only X and Y swap; Z and T unchanged. Stack lift enabled. Useful for argument reversal.

description: Recall last X (value before last operation)
notes: LASTX is saved before most operations. Useful for error recovery or reusing an operand.

description: Push pi onto X (3.141592654, 10-digit rounded)
notes: Pushes pi onto stack (stack lift occurs). Precision is 10 significant digits per HP-41 OM.

description: Truncate X toward zero (integer part)
notes: Truncates toward zero (not floor). LASTX saved. Stack lift enabled.

description: Round X to precision of current display mode
Fractional part of X (sign-preserving)
Absolute value of X
notes: Modifies X in place; stack unchanged. Stack lift enabled after.

description: Sign of X: -1, 0, or +1
Factorial of integer X; OutOfRange for X>69
divergences: FACT effective cap <= 26 per Phase 27 proptest calibration; X in 27..=69 returns Overflow via the Decimal::from_f64 wall

description: Reciprocal of X
notes: Returns 1 divided by X; DATA ERROR if X=0. LASTX saved. Stack lift enabled.

description: Square root of X
notes: DATA ERROR if X < 0. LASTX saved. Stack lift enabled after.

description: Square of X
notes: Replaces X with X squared. LASTX saved. Stack lift enabled.

description: Y raised to power X
notes: Y is base, X is exponent. Stack drops; T replicates. LASTX=X.

description: Y mod X with trunc-toward-zero convention
notes: Result sign follows Y (HP-41C/CV QRG). -7 MOD 3 -> -1. Stack drops.

description: Percent change from Y to X: ((X-Y)/Y)*100
Natural logarithm of X
notes: DATA ERROR if X <= 0. LASTX saved. Stack lift enabled.

description: Base-10 logarithm of X
notes: DATA ERROR if X <= 0. LASTX saved. Use 10^X to invert.

description: Natural exponential of X
notes: Raises e to X. LASTX saved. Stack lift enabled after.

description: Base-10 exponential of X
Sine of X (in current angle mode)
notes: Uses current angle mode (DEG/RAD/GRAD). LASTX saved. Stack lift enabled.

description: Cosine of X (in current angle mode)
notes: Uses current angle mode (DEG/RAD/GRAD). LASTX saved. Stack lift enabled.

description: Tangent of X (in current angle mode)
notes: DATA ERROR at 90 deg. LASTX saved. Stack lift enabled.

description: Arc sine of X (result in current angle mode)
notes: Domain: -1 <= X <= 1; DATA ERROR outside. Result in current angle mode.

description: ENG n - engineering notation display (n=0..9)
notes: Exponent is always a multiple of 3 (kilo/mega/etc). Display mode only.
